name: ICOMM Technologies Inc.
old_description: TECHNOLOGIES INC. - 5 GREAT VALLEY PKWY, SUITE 210, MALVERN PA 19355
about:
ICOMM Technologies Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania. The fabless semiconductor company operates from an office at 5 Great Valley Parkway, Suite 210, and focuses on the design and development of wireless baseband processors for evolving mobile communication standards.

The company provides full custom ASIC design services and partners with back-end design house ICNexus and wafer foundry Fujitsu in Asia to deliver 90 nm and finer geometry ASIC design and fabrication. Its core expertise lies in 3G, 4G, and 5G baseband processor development, including beamforming, beamsteering, and array antenna technologies for 5G networks. ICOMM also conducts research into green energy technology for next-generation wireless systems.

ICOMM serves the wireless communications industry, supplying baseband processor solutions for smartphones, business automation, and autonomous vehicle applications. Its ASIC design and foundry services cater to semiconductor companies seeking low-cost, low-power, high-quality silicon with quick turnaround. The company's green energy R&D targets sustainable technology for future mobile networks.

ICOMM differentiates itself through its fabless model combined with established Asian foundry partnerships, enabling deep submicron capabilities without owning fabrication facilities. The company emphasizes low-cost, low-power, high-quality ASIC services with rapid delivery, and positions itself as a leader in 5G baseband processor innovation.
